def progress(value):

def guard(deadline):
    if time.time()>=deadline:raise TimeoutError('original whole phase budget exhausted; no extension')
    if int(Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current').read_text())>15*1024**3:raise RuntimeError('memory current including cache>15GiB')
    if shutil.disk_usage(root).free<8*1024**3:raise RuntimeError('free disk<8GiB')

def phase(name,command,deadline):
    started=time.perf_counter();guard(deadline)
    receipt={'command':command,'cwd':str(pin),'source_commit':source,'started_epoch':time.time(),
             'absolute_deadline_epoch':deadline,'remaining_whole_seconds_at_launch':deadline-time.time(),
             'PYTHONPATH':env['PYTHONPATH'],'OMP_NUM_THREADS':'1','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS':'1'}
    (directory/(name+'-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
    failure=None
    with (directory/(name+'.stdout.log')).open('x')as stdout,(directory/(name+'.stderr.log')).open('x')as stderr:
        child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=pin,env=env,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr,start_new_session=True)
        while child.poll()is None:
            try:guard(deadline)
            except Exception as error:failure=repr(error)
            progress({'status':'running','phase':name,'pid':child.pid,'whole_elapsed_seconds':time.perf_counter()-started,
                      'remaining_whole_seconds':deadline-time.time()})
            if failure:
                try:os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
                except ProcessLookupError:pass
                try:child.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL);child.wait(timeout=5)
                break
            time.sleep(1)
    if time.time()>=deadline and failure is None:failure='original whole deadline exceeded at returned completion'
    receipt.update(returncode=child.returncode,failure=failure,whole_wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started,finished_epoch=time.time())
    (directory/(name+'-result.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'phase':name,'returncode':child.returncode,'failure':failure,'whole_wall_seconds':receipt['whole_wall_seconds']}),flush=True)
    if child.returncode or failure:raise RuntimeError('stopped phase: '+name)
    return receipt
